## Checks
- [ ] CI is green (style rules, secret scan, types, lint, unit tests, audit, build, browser tests)
- [ ] If this fixes a bug: a test was added that fails when the fix is reverted (say which)
- [ ] If a study page changed: `node tools/sync-content.mjs` was run, and its version, date and changelog line were updated
- [ ] No secrets, company or personal data, or copied document text
- [ ] Looked at both themes (night and light) and at 375 px if the UI changed
